text:
Type: narrow metal drawer unit on casters
Use: storing papers, stationery and small supplies beside a desk; home office, study, craft room
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: powder-coated steel body and drawers, chrome pulls with label holders, small casters
Colors: dark black-brown, silver chrome
Shape: tall slim box with six shallow drawers, bin-pull style metal handles, flat top, small casters, compact and upright, light visual weight
Feel: functional, sturdy, sleek, studious
Goes with: dark or light wood desks, white walls, black accents; industrial or modern home offices and workspaces

product.name: HELMER
product.description: Slot for label on each drawer so you can easily keep things organised and find what you are looking for.
